_comment: Hermes Agent MCP descriptor (ADR-0100). Hermes reads MCP servers ONLY from the `mcp_servers:` block of $HERMES_HOME/config.yaml (native-mcp docs) — it has no per-project descriptor file and no ${VAR} expansion — so this file documents the canonical entry for manual wiring; adapters/hermes/install.sh is what actually writes it, through `hermes config set` (never a hand-edited config.yaml: Hermes's own invariant is that a stray indent breaks the live gateway). Hermes namespaces every server tool mcp_<server>_<tool>, so the server named `skill-search` exposes mcp_skill_search_search_skills / mcp_skill_search_get_skill. Env block is kept in strict lockstep with .mcp.json (scripts/check_mcp_env_parity.py). The installer adds SKILL_CONCIERGE_HARNESS=hermes when it writes the entry (the DSH precedent: a harness stamp lives in the harness's own config, never in the shipped descriptor); SKILL_SERVER_RECORDS is omitted here deliberately — the engine's Path.home() default resolves the same directory without a machine-pinned literal.
